standing: CANDIDATE - TEST-ONLY, NOT APPROVED, NOT LIVE. Our wording (ours, unreviewed) of High Press Escape's four coach rules with the approved row's own 'through the next action' in place of 'with the next pass' and, since stage B2 of the A02 complete-activity package (12 November 2026), the declared changes: 'its' (ours, whose action), and the origin sentence replaced by the observable condition of Christian's ruling received 12 November 2026 (dropped from the setups); every other word kept. Held for Christian's review alongside the complete A02 activity, never released. Read only by unit tests, through the tests-only reader back/src/system/sport-module/candidate-coach-rules.ts; no route, no engine module and no approved wording table reads it (primary-scoring.unit.ts holds that by a scan). The live rules (back/src/system/sport-module/primary-scoring.ts, COACH_RULES) are unchanged: a change of live coach text is Christian's production decision, held for the same release decision as the three approved Attack Development rules.
label: CANDIDATE
about: A02 package, stage W3 (11 November 2026): the source-to-code check of the four RPC-002 coach rules against RPC-PROP-133 and the other approved rows of RPC-002, clause by clause (sourceToCode), and the smallest correction of the one clause the check finds narrowed (replacement), with the questions the corrected wording leaves open (questions). Held to the approved rows by primary-scoring.unit.ts: every clause verbatim in its live rule or setup, every source's words verbatim in its row and its line the row's key, every candidate the live rule with only the replacement made, and every rule containing the replaced words covered.

authority.quote: Please include a focused source-to-code check in the A02 work and prepare the smallest correction that faithfully preserves the approved meaning.

basis.reading: Ours: 'pass' names one kind of action where the approved row names any action, so the live wording is narrower than its source. Restoring the row's own words decides nothing new: no approved row of RPC-002 names a pass as the next action (the check below reads every RPC-002 row). What 'the next action' means in play is not decided here: questions Q-a to Q-d.
basis.productionBoundary: Not live. Writing the candidate into COACH_RULES changes what coaches are served, which Christian keeps: "Production deployment or changes to live coach-facing behavior." (item 6, received 11 November 2026, second reply). Held for the same release decision as the three approved Attack Development rules.
